passages.original: I. Præterea Dionysius aliam ad Sixlum scripsit epistolam, quam Eusebius, lib. VII, Hist., c. 9, his verbis indicare satis habuit: « Est et quinta ejusdem Dionysii epistola de baptismo, ipsius et ecclesiae quam regebat nomine, ad Sixtum et ecclesiam urbis RoraBo, in qua de proposita quæstione prolixam admodum disputationem instituit.
passages.english: I. Besides this, Dionysius wrote another letter to Sixtus, which Eusebius, in Book VII of the History, chapter 9, was content to indicate in these words: "There is also a fifth letter of the same Dionysius on baptism, [written] in his own name and that of the church which he governed, to Sixtus and the church of the city of Rome, in which he sets out a very lengthy discussion of the question put forward.
passages.notes: "Sixlum" and "RoraBo" are scanning errors for "Sixtum" and "Romanæ" ("of Rome"). The quotation from Eusebius is closed in the following context.
